resolvedFindings.problem: Initial template had performance and stop targets without corresponding measured goodput, success denominator, runtime, latency, and distinct local/AP/provider stop records.
resolvedFindings.fixVerified: Added required measurement fields and definitions for same measurement window, verified payload goodput, attempts/successes, RTT nearest-rank p95 and sample count, monotonic runtime, independent local/AP/provider stop observations from one request origin. Provider unknown remains null plus unknown; acknowledgement alone is not a network fence. Null or unmeasured criteria cannot pass.

independentChecks: Read both final documents and parsed the JSON template; required measurement field names unique and complete for the resolved finding.
Official source review supports the core published modem, antenna and battery numbers and distinguishes message/UDP services from general IP sharing.
Antenna ground plane, maximum input power, modem approval, complete pack versus bare cell, device certification, sharing terms and contract liability remain explicit preconditions.
Standalone internal battery/antenna use, in-use height at most 200 mm, and all four display constraints are preserved; external terminal runs cannot be standalone acceptance.
All trial stages NOT_RUN; no execution, physical acceptance, provider connection or invoice verification asserted.
Plan separates local control evidence, simulated provider protocol, Linux packet evidence, physical radio tests and final invoice reconciliation.
Independent arithmetic confirms ideal 1 MB transfer times about 91/364 seconds, 70 mm square diagonal about 99 mm, and hypothetical usable energies 7.488/12.6 Wh.

limitations: This is preparation-document acceptance only, not hardware selection, procurement, contract approval, RF transmission permission, device acceptance or a billing guarantee.
No hardware, Wi-Fi radio/WPA handshake, satellite path, provider hard cap, closed enclosure, battery endurance or invoice test was independently executed.
Published sources do not establish a particular modem/antenna/pack combination or general internet sharing permission; region, use case, exact revisions and commercial terms remain unresolved.
No provider contact or network service contract was sent. Adjacent metadata under concurrent editing was outside this review.
Template remains a manual blank record, not an executable acceptance validator; measurements and approval evidence must be supplied before a trial can pass.
